mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loyalty.rule_definition (id, tenant_id, program_id, code, name, domain, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{programId}, #{code}, #{name}, #{domain}, 'ACTIVE')
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, program_id, code, name, domain, status, created_at FROM loyalty.rule_definition WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND program_id = #{programId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY code
